pr_title: Add support for git flags in gh repo fork
pr_body:
Fix #2236 

I added the same custom error msg from #1475 for `gh repo fork` when trying to use unknown git flags.

issue_context.title: support gitflags in gh repo fork
issue_context.body:
### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

I want to create a fork and then clone it locally shallowly. This is not possible since `gh repo fork --clone` does not provide any options and does not return the repo name in a clean way.

### Proposed solution

```sh
gh repo clone -- --depth 1 --single-branch $(gh repo fork --clone=false)
```

or accept gitflags [like `gh repo clone` does](https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_repo_clone)

```sh
gh repo fork --clone -- --depth 1 --single-branch
```

## How will it benefit CLI and its users?

This speeds up the cloning progress. Adding support for gitflags will also align `repo fork` with `repo clone`
comments: Having this mirror `repo clone` by supporting gitflags does make sense to me. @ampinsk do you have any objection to that?
@vilmibm no objection! makes sense to me
